**Finding submitted: deviation (LD — liquidated damages payable by Customer).**

- **Responsive clause:** Section 4.2 (p0025–p0029) — the only Customer-payable stipulated amount in the document. Triggered by *any* termination by the Company (including 90-day non-renewal under 4.1), calculated as half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales over $800,000, paid in eight quarterly instalments.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the amount is uncapped and is measured off Net Sales, whereas our fees are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month — so it can far exceed three months' fees. Nothing elsewhere (Sections 3, 6, 9, 10) imposes any other penalty or minimum on us; HDI-side amounts are not flagged.
- **Target chosen:** fallback rather than preferred, since deleting Section 4.2 would require collateral rewrites of the Section 4 heading and the zero-floor/instalment mechanics.
- **Cure:** one inserted proviso (4.2(d)) capping the Termination Payment at the fees payable under Section 3.1 for the three months preceding the Termination Date and confirming it is the only liquidated amount or penalty payable by the Company. The Customer-favourable zero-floor in 4.2(b) and the instalment mechanic in 4.2(c) are left intact and remain coherent with the capped amount.
